mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over the horizon in the same regime.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 6.7% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and investment.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite UNRATE crossing above 6.7% in the same regime.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) proxies signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and INDPRO does not significantly predict positive returns (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower future rates.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite FEDFUNDS declining in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past quarter predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates further economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite GDPC1 trending upward in the same regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 16,000 in the next month triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market reacts to strong economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both unemployment (UNRATE) and federal funds rates signals tightening labor markets and higher inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rising in the same regime.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) alongside falling federal funds rates predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets reassess growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies move in the expected direction in the regime.
